signature.composition: big blue anchor under orange tag joined by short tether

prompt: One SQUARE flat software icon on pure white for locking a PLC tag in place. Draw a huge, simple NAVY SHIP ANCHOR with a vertical shaft and two broad upward-curving flukes. Directly above the anchor attach one large ORANGE TAG with a white hole to the anchor ring, visibly securing it. The whole shape is a bold anchor silhouette with orange tag on top, no square background. No chains, padlocks, shields, keys, hands, arrows, text or shadows. Very simple thick shapes that survive 30x18; keep artwork in central 70 percent of square.
